shell_commands:
/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,520p' ../round-brief.md
git status --short --branch
rg -n \"list_sessions|session_list|validated by\" specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md .lore/test-commands.yml
rg -n \"reanchor|spec-links\" scripts package.json"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "sed -n '1,190p' .lore/test-commands.yml
sed -n '1,190p' specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md
sed -n '60,100p' specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md
rg -n \""'^'"\\s*(it|test)\\(\" src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts
sed -n '1,125p' src/transport/ws/messageHandler.test.ts
git log -3 --oneline --stat"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "node - <<'NODE'
const fs=require('fs'),path=require('path');let bad=0;
for(const root of ['specs','adrs'])if(fs.existsSync(root))for(const d of fs.readdirSync(root,{recursive:true}))if(d.endsWith('.md')){const f=path.join(root,d),s=fs.readFileSync(f,'utf8'),re=/\\[validated by: (["'^'"\\]]+)\\]\\((\\.\\.\\/\\.\\.\\/["'^)#]+)#L('"\\d+)\\)/g;for(const m of s.matchAll(re)){const target=path.resolve(path.dirname(f),m[2]),line=+m[3],got=fs.existsSync(target)?fs.readFileSync(target,'utf8').split('\\n')[line-1]||'':'MISSING';if("'!got.includes(m[1])){console.log(`${f}: ${path.relative('"'.',target)}:"'${line} expected ${m[1]} | ${got.trim()}`);bad++}}}console.log(`mismatches ${bad}`)
NODE
git diff --check'

/usr/bin/zsh -lc "git diff --check
git status --short
git diff --stat
git diff -- specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md | sed -n '1,260p'"

/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git add .lore/dod.md specs/hal-engine-abandon-on-close/spec.md specs/hal-engine-commit-open-entries/spec.md specs/hal-engine-conversation-list/spec.md specs/hal-engine-session-resume/spec.md specs/hal-engine-single-terminal-frame/spec.md specs/hal-engine-tool-budget/spec.md specs/hal-engine-tool-executor-throw/spec.md specs/hal-engine-websocket-protocol/spec.md && git commit -m "docs(protocol): document conversation list frames" && git push origin HEAD'
/usr/bin/zsh -lc 'git fetch origin main && git merge --no-edit origin/main'
